visibleInstruction.content: Zef と Tal を同時に 'pex' へ進める新しい operation 'kindleBoth' を追加せよ。

explicitWorkingNote.content: Added atomic kindleBoth: it requires both Zef and Tal to be nim, then returns an immutable state with both set to pex. Registered the operation without changing the WorldProtocol method signatures or existing operations.
